text: No file under roles/, playbooks/ or osbuild.yml references osbuild_components or osbuild_component_defs (grep returns nothing).
roles/osbuild/tasks/validate_components.yml is deleted, and tasks/main.yml no longer imports it or sets osbuild_component_sources.
vars/packages/{Fedora,AlmaLinux,Rocky}.yml, roles/osbuild/vars/packages.yml and the 'Load package taxonomy' task are deleted. No system_packages or system_groups reference remains.
Template mode is gone: blueprint.toml.j2, osbuild_use_blueprint_template and osbuild_blueprint_template no longer exist in the role or the playbooks.
osbuild_blueprint_components keeps its name and is the only variable that selects packages for a build.
Component files accept optional fields flatpaks, bootc_repos and copr_repos, and the schema comment in defaults/main.yml documents every component field.
The bootc path (build.sh.j2, files/bootc/build.yml) reads packages, services, flatpaks and repos from the loaded component files. Its nvidia checks test 'nvidia' in osbuild_blueprint_components.
Component files and a frames/workstation.toml exist for rocky/10, rocky/9, almalinux/10 and fedora/43 (x86_64).

For almalinux/10, rocky/9 and fedora/43, each former static workstation blueprint (plain and -nvidia variants) has a component list whose merged package set equals the package set of that static TOML.
The static workstation TOMLs that were split into component files are deleted.
osbuild-almalinux-iso.yml and osbuild-almalinux-iso-nvidia.yml build from osbuild_blueprint_components instead of a static blueprint.
osbuild.yml and playbooks/osbuild.yml pick osbuild_blueprint_components from the target distro and work on Fedora 43, Rocky 9/10 and AlmaLinux 10 hosts.
osbuild-rocky-iso.yml, osbuild-rocky-iso-nvidia.yml, osbuild-rocky-iso-nvidia-generate.yml and osbuild-rocky-iso-nvidia-interactive.yml are deleted. The *-components.yml playbooks remain.

osbuild-rocky-cuda-container.yml uses a cuda-container component plus frames/container.toml (set through osbuild_blueprint_frame_path), and its generated blueprint has the same packages as the old static container TOML.
A generate-only run of osbuild-rocky-iso-components.yml, -nvidia-components.yml and -intel-oneapi-components.yml writes a blueprint identical to the one written before the change.
ansible-playbook --syntax-check passes for every remaining playbook.
scripts/package_tracker.py reads and writes only roles/osbuild/files/<distro>/<major>/<arch>/components/*.yml and never touches vars/packages.
The tracker finds every components directory. --target <distro>/<major>/<arch> selects one; without it the CLI exits with an error that lists the available targets.
'package_tracker.py list --target T' prints every component in T with its label and package count.
'package_tracker.py search NAME' prints every target/component that contains a matching package.

'package_tracker.py add --target T COMPONENT PKG...' appends the packages to that component file, keeps comments, key order and sorted order unchanged, and does nothing for a package already in the component.
Adding a package that already exists in another component of the same target prints a warning naming that component and is refused unless --force is given. The TUI asks for confirmation instead.

'package_tracker.py remove --target T COMPONENT PKG...' removes the packages from that component file and keeps comments. Removing the last package is refused, because a component needs a non-empty packages list.
'add --verify' checks each package against the target's repos before writing. Names starting with @ skip the check.
The 'build' manifest subcommand and the TaxonomyManager class are removed from the tracker.
The TUI asks for a target only when more than one exists, then shows a list of components (label + count).
Choosing a component opens a submenu with these actions: Edit packages, Add packages, Show details, Back.
'Edit packages' shows a checkbox list of the component's packages with all items checked. Unchecked items are removed from the file after a confirmation that lists them.
'Show details' prints the component's label, repo_urls, services, kernel_args and fragment.
'Back' returns to the component list, and the component list has a Back option that returns to the main menu.
tests/test_package_tracker.py is rewritten against temporary fixture component directories and passes under pytest, covering list, search, add, remove, the duplicate warning and comment preservation.
The README and the syncopated skill docs no longer mention osbuild_components, osbuild_component_defs or vars/packages, and they describe the new tracker commands.
